channel.description:
Nature Communications is an open access, multidisciplinary journal dedicated to publishing high-quality research in all areas of the biological, health, physical, chemical and Earth sciences. Papers published by the journal aim to represent important advances of significance to specialists within each field.

We are committed to providing an efficient service for both authors and readers. Our team of independent editors make rapid and fair publication decisions. Prompt dissemination of accepted papers to a wide readership and beyond is achieved through a programme of continuous online publication.

item.title: [8] Checkerboard-type Zhang-Rice states in overdoped cuprate superconductors
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Mi Jiang, Xinmao Yin

Authors: Xiongfang Liu, Kun Han, Yan Peng, et al.

Score 8/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Broadband spectroscopy study of electronic reconstruction in overdoped cuprates, relevant to unconventional superconductivity.

Tags: #method:opticalspectroscopy #material:cuprate #topic:superconductivity

Abstract: In cuprate superconductors, the overdoped regime has received comparatively limited attention. Here, broadband optical spectroscopy and DQMC calculations reveal an electronic reconstruction in LSCO beyond x > 0.2, consistent with a checkerboard Zhang–Rice configuration hosting coexisting localized and itinerant carriers.
